learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to count to 10, make fun groups of 10, and find numbers that add up to 10!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at your hands! You have 5 fingers on one hand and 5 fingers on the other. Put them together and you get 10 fingers!
When we have many loose things like sticks or beads, we count 10 of them. Then we put them in a box or tie them to make one special group of 10!
Numbers love to join hands to make 10! 9 and 1 make 10. 6 and 4 make 10. They are best friends!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Magic 10 Hunt!
fun_activity.instructions: Go around your house and collect exactly 10 toys, 10 crayons, or 10 spoons. Put them in a beautiful circle on the floor!

quick_recap: ⭐ 10 is a very special number that we use all the time.
⭐ We have 10 fingers on our hands and 10 toes on our feet.
⭐ We can make a group of 10 by putting 10 small things together!
